This release fixes bugs reported on the original Nilesoft Shell. Each item names the upstream issue or pull request (`moudey/Shell#123`).

**Menus**
- On Windows in a language other than English, items that Shell moves into *File manage*, *Pin/Unpin* and *Terminal* (for example Windows' *Copy as path*) no longer disappear. Pin and unpin items are matched by id instead of by their English title. (#477, PR #843)
- *File manage > New* creates the folder or file in the folder you right-clicked again. Since 2.0.0 it used Explorer's own working folder.
- Repeated *Eject* entries stay in the *Safely Remove Hardware* tray menu. (#583)
- *Terminal* and *Develop* items are hidden on Library folders, where they could not open. (#688, #385)
- *File manage > Take ownership* makes the signed-in user the owner instead of the administrator account that approved the prompt. (#690)
- Long menu item titles are no longer cut at 259 characters.
- Commands started from the menu get their own COM apartment and start synchronously, which fixes items that sometimes did nothing.
- On Windows 11, menus with blur or acrylic get the system's smooth rounded corners. (#141)
- Clicking an item no longer leaves a black block where the item was. Windows fades the clicked item out from a copy of it, which came out black; Shell switches that fade off for the one click again, as the original did.

**Configuration language**
- The documented `default` item property works: the item is drawn bold. (#188)
- `theme.font.quality` sets the text antialiasing, including ClearType for opaque menus. (#776)
- `io.delete(path, true)` deletes a folder with its contents; links inside it are removed without following them. (#788)
- `io.file.write`, `create` and `append` write characters above U+7FFF (most Chinese, Japanese and Korean text, and emoji) correctly. (#786)
- `type = '...'` and `clsid = '...'` accept spaces around `=` in `modify(...)`. (#708)
- `clipboard.is_empty` returns 1 when the clipboard has no text. (#515)
- `sys.temp` returns the system temporary folder; `user.temp` stays the user's. (#508)
- New ids for the rename box menu, and `id.play_with_windows_media_player` matches again. (#248)

**Languages**
- Dutch (`nl.nss`), contributed by YESNLars. (PR #832)
- *Go to > Folder* titles are translated, and every language file has the keys added in this fork. (#726)
- Hong Kong and Macau use Traditional Chinese; other Chinese locales use Simplified Chinese. Fixes in the Traditional Chinese and Korean files.

**Under the hood**
- `shell.log` can be read while Explorer has it open, and two threads can no longer open it at once. (#715)
- The program manifest is valid, so its DPI, long path and UTF-8 settings take effect.
- Registry string values are written with their terminator.

**Documentation**
- Corrections to the import syntax, `sys.datetime` ("Y" and "y"), `sel.path.name` and `sel.path.title`, the selection modes, `io.file.create`, and what Ctrl+Win does. (#541, #787, #812, #395, #352, PR #831, PR #837)
